title: CV0 Trust Layer - verdict (spec v3.5)
description: The verdict over claims, produced against a criteria-locked claims.md and a fixed object_version. Append-only: a superseded verdict is never overwritten - a new verdict_id is issued. Independent verifiers issue their OWN verdict_id against the same criteria_lock rather than amending the author's verdict. The schema validates structure; PASS/FAIL meaning is bound to the claims text frozen in claims.md.

valid_until.description: Explicit expiry date, or the literal 'object-change' (validity ends when the object changes).

object_version.description: Commit/release/model version of the object the verdict applies to. Reproductions MUST pin this, never HEAD.

verifier.description: Who verified. Author self-verification is allowed but MUST state that it is not independent.

control.description: Negative control id from the evidence manifest.

reason_code.description: Scientific: DATA, GRAMMAR, NOISE, DEPTH. Operational: ACCESS, BUDGET, ENVIRONMENT, CONFLICT_EVIDENCE, OUT_OF_SCOPE.

then.description: A statistical PASS (verification references a repeated-runs procedure such as V-02) requires a negative control reference with N >= 1 in the manifest.

negative_controls.description: Control outcomes backing the PASS claims: id, N, false-acceptance count/rate. '0 false' without N is not accepted.
